resources.string: If Harbor or a game crashes, Harbor can save a report on this phone: what crashed and the last lines of its log, with account ids, names, tokens and typed text removed. Nothing is sent anywhere. At the next start Harbor offers the report: you can read it, share it yourself, or delete it.\n\nKeep crash reports?
Harbor saved a crash report: %1$s (%2$s).\n\nIt is kept on this phone only; nothing has been sent. View it, share it yourself, or delete it.
